website.how: The site is titled "Ed Case for Congress" and describes him as the Congressman representing Hawaii's First District, asking for support; its footer is dated 2026.

The site is paid for by Tokuda for Hawaii, names Jill Tokuda, speaks of "our district" from Hilo to Hanalei, and points readers who wanted her official House of Representatives website to tokuda.house.gov; it does not spell out the district number itself.
The site is titled "Brenton Awa for US Congress 2026" and names the 2nd Congressional District (HI-02).
